title: From Unity Simulation to Diffusion-Based Augmentation: Quantifying Dataset Balance for Robust Object Detection
title_zh: 从Unity Simulation到基于扩散的增强：量化数据集平衡以实现稳健的目标检测

paragraphs.en: Modern computer vision models achieve high accuracy when trained on large-scale annotated datasets. In critical domains such as construction safety monitoring, data collection is costly, hazardous, and ethically constrained. This paper presents a systematic study comparing two complementary data generation paradigms, (1) Unity Simulation-based rendering and (2) Controllable Diffusion-based generation (CIA), for object detection under real data-scarce conditions. A unified experimental framework enables controlled dataset mixing across real, simulated, and generative sources, while maintaining identical model and training settings. Quantitative evaluation using Precision, Recall, mAP, and custom Δ \Delta -metrics, reveals that neither simulation nor generative augmentation alone achieves optimal transferability. Unity-only training yields an mAP@0.5 drop of − 50 % -50\% relative to real data, while CIA-only training shows a milder − 16.5 % -16.5\% degradation. Hybrid compositions significantly improve performance, with the 90% real + 10% Unity configuration achieving the best overall mAP@0.5 of 62.68 % 62.68\% ( + 7.64 % +7.64\% over baseline), and the 90% real + 10% CIA configuration maximizing precision at 74.45 % 74.45\% . Results demonstrate that limited synthetic inclusion enhances generalization, while excessive substitution induces domain drift.
paragraphs.zh: 现代计算机视觉模型在基于大规模标注数据集进行训练时，能够达到很高的准确率。 在建筑安全监测等关键领域，数据收集成本高昂、存在风险，且受到伦理方面的限制。 本文提出了一项系统性研究，比较了两种互补的数据生成范式：（1）基于 Unity 模拟的渲染和（2）基于可控扩散的生成（CIA），用于在真实数据稀缺条件下进行目标检测。 一个统一的实验框架使得真实、模拟和生成数据源之间的数据集混合受到控制，同时保持了模型和训练设置的完全一致。 通过精度、召回率、mAP 以及自定义 Δ \Delta -指标进行的定量评估表明，单独使用模拟或生成增强都无法实现最佳的迁移能力。 仅使用 Unity 进行训练时，与真实数据相比，mAP@0.5 下降了 −50%；而仅使用 CIA 进行训练的模型则表现出较轻微的 −16.5% 性能下降。 混合组合显著提升了性能：90% 真实数据 + 10% Unity 的配置实现了最高的整体 mAP@0.5（62.68%，比基线提升 7.64%）；而 90% 真实数据 + 10% CIA 的配置则将精度最大化至 74.45%。 实验结果表明，有限比例的合成数据引入能够增强模型泛化能力，而过度的替代则会引发领域漂移。

paragraphs.en: Modern deep object detectors such as YOLO ( Redmon et al., 2016 ) achieve remarkable accuracy when trained on large-scale datasets. However, in industrial or safety critical contexts (e.g., construction sites or railway environments) obtaining labeled data is logistically difficult, costly, and often unsafe ( Kim et al., 2025 ) . Scenes are dynamic, lighting varies, and safety incidents cannot ethically be staged for data capture. Consequently, these systems are limited by data scarcity rather than by model capacity.
paragraphs.zh: 现代深度目标检测器（如 YOLO (Redmon et al., 2016)）在大规模数据集上进行训练时，能够取得显著的准确率。 然而，在工业或安全关键场景（例如建筑工地或铁路环境）中，获取带标签的数据在后勤上存在困难、成本高昂，且通常不安全 (Kim et al., 2025)。 这些场景是动态变化的，光照条件各不相同，而且出于伦理考虑，无法人为制造安全事故来采集数据。 因此，这些系统的性能受限并非源于模型能力不足，而是由于数据稀缺。

paragraphs.en: Data scarcity prompted a wide spectrum of strategies aimed at reducing reliance on large annotated datasets. few-shot ( Wang et al., 2020 ; Snell et al., 2017 ) and zero-shot learning ( Radford et al., 2021 ) , exploit transfer learning and language–vision alignment to generalize from limited examples. Semi-supervised and self-supervised approaches ( Kotthapalli et al., 2025 ) leverage unlabeled data to learn robust feature representations. Domain adaptation ( Tzeng et al., 2017 ) aligns distributions between source and target domains to mitigate the so called sim-to-real gap.
paragraphs.zh: 数据稀缺性促使人们提出了多种策略，旨在减少对大型标注数据集的依赖。小样本学习（Wang 等人，2020；Snell 等人，2017）和零样本学习（Radford 等人，2021）利用迁移学习和语言与视觉的对齐，从而在有限示例中实现泛化。 半监督学习和自监督学习方法（Kotthapalli 等人，2025）利用未标注数据来学习稳健的特征表示。 领域自适应（Tzeng 等人，2017）通过对齐源域和目标域之间的分布，以缓解所谓的“模拟到现实”差距。

paragraphs.en: Simulation-based data generation , where game/virtual environments platforms render photorealistic and precisely annotated scenes with controllable geometry, lighting, and occlusion patterns. Popular platforms include Unity ( Haas, 2014 ; Unity, 2025 ) , Unreal Engine ( Games, 2025 ) , or the more research focused CARLA ( Dosovitskiy et al., 2017 ) .

This is done by offering modular stages for control condition extraction, conditioned diffusion-based generation, image quality filtering, dataset integration, and parallelized model training.

paragraphs.en: We present a benchmarking between Unity-based simulation and diffusion-based augmentation (CIA) for object detection, under controlled data volume and model settings.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在受控的数据量和模型设置下，对基于 Unity 的模拟与基于扩散的增强（CIA）在物体检测方面的表现进行了基准对比。

paragraphs.en: We quantify the separate and combined impact of different real, simulated, and generated data, on detection performance across multiple dataset mixtures. That is done through a joint analysis of simulation domain gap, generative bias, and dataset composition synergy.
paragraphs.zh: 我们对不同真实数据、模拟数据和生成数据在多种数据集混合中的独立及联合影响，对检测性能造成的影响进行了量化分析。 这是通过联合分析模拟域差异、生成偏差以及数据集组成之间的协同效应来实现的。

paragraphs.en: We provide a unified, reproducible pipeline built entirely with open-source tools, designed for broader adoption in industrial and academic contexts where synthetic and generative data must be jointly leveraged.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提供了一套完全由开源工具构建的统一、可复现的流程，旨在更广泛地应用于工业和学术领域，在这些领域中，合成数据和生成数据必须被联合利用。

paragraphs.en: Synthetic rendering has been adopted for vision tasks training, due to its controllability, cost-efficiency, and ability to simulate rare objects or scenarios. CARLA for example, published by Dosovitskiy et al. (2014) ( Dosovitskiy et al., 2017 ) , enabled simulation based autonomous vehicle training and research when real world data capture was dangerous. Zhang et al. (2016) ( Zhang et al., 2017 ) systematically studied synthetic rendering for indoor scene understanding, generating 500K synthetic images from 45K realistic 3D scenes. They showed that more realistic rendering improves performance on tasks like semantic segmentation and surface normal prediction.
paragraphs.zh: 由于合成渲染具备可控性、成本效益高，并且能够模拟罕见物体或场景，因此已被用于视觉任务的训练。例如，由 Dosovitskiy 等人（2014）（Dosovitskiy et al., 2017）发布的 CARLA 在现实世界数据收集存在危险时，为基于模拟的自动驾驶车辆训练和研究提供了可能。Zhang 等人（2016）（Zhang et al., 2017）系统性地研究了合成渲染在室内场景理解中的应用，从 4.5 万个逼真的三维场景中生成了 50 万张合成图像。他们表明，更逼真的渲染能够提升语义分割和表面法线预测等任务的性能。

(2021) ( Borkman et al., 2021 ) published the Unity Perception plugin, which provides a modular framework for large-scale synthetic dataset generation with automatic ground-truth annotations. It is able to generate object bounding boxes, instance segmentation masks, depth maps, and keypoints. The toolkit integrates domain randomization capabilities.

paragraphs.en: Domain randomization ( Tobin et al., 2017 ) improves transferability by deliberately varying visual factors such as lighting, textures, object colors, camera poses, and backgrounds during rendering. It forces models to rely on invariant structural cues rather than low-level appearance statistics. Hence, this strategy reduces overfitting to specific synthetic textures and narrows the sim-to-real gap.
paragraphs.zh: 领域随机化（Tobin 等人，2017）通过在渲染过程中有意改变光照、纹理、物体颜色、相机姿态和背景等视觉因素，提高了模型的可迁移性。 它迫使模型依赖不变的结构线索，而非低层外观统计信息。 因此，这种策略减少了对特定合成纹理的过拟合，并缩小了仿真到现实的差距。

paragraphs.en: Despite these advances, purely randomized rendering often fails to reproduce the complex photometric and material properties of real environments. For example, global illumination effects, fine-grained surface roughness, or realistic motion blur. As a result, models trained solely on domain randomized synthetic data typically under-perform when evaluated on real world imagery ( Asselin et al., 2020 ) . This limitation motivates hybrid approaches that integrate physically grounded simulation with data-driven generative augmentation, as explored in this work through the combination of Unity-based rendering and diffusion-based synthesis.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管取得了这些进展，但完全随机化的渲染通常无法再现真实环境中复杂的光度特性和材质属性。 例如，全局光照效果、精细的表面粗糙度或逼真的运动模糊。 因此，仅基于领域随机化合成数据训练的模型，在真实世界图像上进行评估时通常表现不佳（Asselin 等人，2020）。 这一局限性推动了混合方法的采用，即将基于物理的模拟与数据驱动的生成交增技术相结合；本研究通过结合 Unity 渲染和扩散模型合成，探索了这一方法。

paragraphs.en: Diffusion models ( Rombach et al., 2022 ; Ho et al., 2020 ) and ControlNet ( Zhang et al., 2023 ) have revolutionized controllable image generation, enabling generative conditioning on edges, poses, or semantic maps. Thus, allowing task specific synthesis. CIA ( Benkedadra et al., 2024 ) leverages diffusion models for data augmentation via extraction of structural features and conditions, controlled synthesis, and quality filtering. This type of augmentation has proven effective, but pretrained diffusion models can introduce semantic bias from internet scale training corpora ( Yamaguchi and Fukuda, 2023 ; Luccioni et al., 2023 ; Perera and Patel, 2023 ) .

paragraphs.en: Bridging the sim-to-real gap has been a longstanding challenge ( Tobin et al., 2017 ; Peng et al., 2018 ) . Recent data-centric AI paradigms ( Jakubik et al., 2024 ) emphasize dataset quality, balance, and representativeness over model complexity. Our work aligns with this direction by empirically quantifying how synthetic and generative data affect generalization in real-world evaluation.

paragraphs.en: In Diffusion-based augmentation, the Controllable Image Augmentation (CIA) framework ( Benkedadra et al., 2024 ) enhances data diversity by generating photorealistic variants of existing samples while preserving their structural semantics.
paragraphs.zh: 在基于扩散的增强方法中，可控图像增强（Controllable Image Augmentation, CIA）框架（Benkedadra 等人，2024）通过生成现有样本的光学真实变体，同时保留其结构语义，从而提升了数据的多样性。

paragraphs.en: Given an image I i ∈ 𝒟 real I_{i}\in\mathcal{D}_{\text{real}} , a configurable encoder ℰ \mathcal{E} extracts structural control features. F i F_{i} can represent edge maps, depth projections, or semantic segmentation masks depending on the selected control mode.
paragraphs.zh: 给定一张图像 I i ∈ 𝒟 real I_{i}\in\mathcal{D}_{\text{real}}，一个可配置的编码器 ℰ \mathcal{E} 会提取结构控制特征。 F i F_{i} 可以根据所选的控制模式表示边缘图、深度投影或语义分割掩码。

sents.en: Given an image I i ∈ 𝒟 real I_{i}\in\mathcal{D}_{\text{real}} , a configurable encoder ℰ \mathcal{E} extracts structural control features.
sents.zh: 给定一张图像 I i ∈ 𝒟 real I_{i}\in\mathcal{D}_{\text{real}}，一个可配置的编码器 ℰ \mathcal{E} 会提取结构控制特征。

sents.en: F i F_{i} can represent edge maps, depth projections, or semantic segmentation masks depending on the selected control mode.
sents.zh: F i F_{i} 可以根据所选的控制模式表示边缘图、深度投影或语义分割掩码。

paragraphs.en: A controlled diffusion generator 𝒢 \mathcal{G} (e.g., Stable Diffusion ( Rombach et al., 2022 ) augmented with ControlNet ( Zhang et al., 2023 ) ) is conditioned on F i F_{i} and a textual prompt C C to synthesize a new image I ~ i \tilde{I}_{i} .
paragraphs.zh: 一个受控扩散生成器 𝒢 \mathcal{G}（例如，通过 ControlNet（Zhang et al., 2023）增强的 Stable Diffusion（Rombach et al., 2022））以 F i F_{i} 和文本提示 C C 为条件，合成一张新图像 I ~ i \tilde{I}_{i}。

paragraphs.en: The generated image I ~ i \tilde{I}_{i} inherits the annotation y i y_{i} from its real counterpart I i I_{i} , yielding the diffusion-augmented dataset.
paragraphs.zh: 生成的图像 I ~ i \tilde{I}_{i} 从其真实对应图像 I i I_{i} 继承了标注 y i y_{i}，从而得到了经过扩散增强的数据集。

paragraphs.en: To ensure photometric realism and semantic fidelity, each generated image is evaluated through a composite quality control function q ⁡ ( I ~ i ) q(\tilde{I}_{i}) , where different metrics like FID , NIMA and CLIP ensure high-quality, label-consistent augmentation.
paragraphs.zh: 为确保光度真实性和语义保真度，每张生成的图像都通过复合质量控制函数 q ⁡ ( I ~ i ) q(\tilde{I}_{i}) 进行评估，其中 FID、NIMA 和 CLIP 等不同指标可确保生成高质量且标签一致的数据增强结果。

paragraphs.en: This process results in a generative dataset 𝒟 cia \mathcal{D}_{\text{cia}} that complements 𝒟 real \mathcal{D}_{\text{real}} by expanding its visual diversity while maintaining semantic alignment with real-world conditions.
paragraphs.zh: 这一过程生成一个生成性数据集 𝒟 cia \mathcal{D}_{\text{cia}}，它在保持与真实世界条件语义对齐的同时，扩展了视觉多样性，从而对 𝒟 real \mathcal{D}_{\text{real}} 形成了补充。

paragraphs.en: In Unity-based simulation augmentation , synthetic datasets are procedurally generated using the Unity Perception toolkit ( Borkman et al., 2021 ) . Each sample is produced by rendering a fully controllable 3D environment with randomized parameters governing lighting, camera pose, surface materials, and object placement, following the domain randomization principle ( Tobin et al., 2017 ) . This approach enables systematic exploration of geometric and photometric variations that are difficult or unsafe to capture in the real world. Formally, the simulated dataset is defined as D unity {D}_{\text{unity}} where each I j u I_{j}^{u} represents a rendered RGB image and y j u y_{j}^{u} its corresponding ground-truth label set (object bounding boxes, segmentation masks, and class identifiers). All annotations are automatically generated at render time through the Unity Perception API, eliminating manual labeling cost and errors.
paragraphs.zh: 在基于 Unity 的模拟增强中，合成数据集通过 Unity Perception 工具包（Borkman 等人，2021）以程序化方式生成。 每个样本都是通过渲染一个完全可控的三维环境生成的，其中光照、相机姿态、表面材质和物体位置等参数均随机化，遵循领域随机化原则（Tobin 等人，2017）。 这种方法使得对几何和光度变化进行系统性探索成为可能，而这些变化在真实世界中难以捕捉或存在安全风险。 形式上，模拟数据集定义为 D_unity {D}_{\text{unity}}，其中每个 I_j^u I_{j}^{u} 表示一张渲染后的 RGB 图像，而 y_j^u y_{j}^{u} 则是其对应的真实标签集（物体边界框、分割掩码和类别标识符）。 所有标注均在渲染时通过 Unity Perception API 自动生成，从而消除了人工标注的成本与错误。

By varying θ u \theta_{u} across render iterations, the simulator yields a diverse, densely annotated dataset that enhances geometric and contextual coverage. However, despite this controllability, synthetic images often diverge from real-world visual statistics. This is due to limited photometric realism. For example, global illumination, micro-texture, and noise characteristics are hard to reproduce.

paragraphs.en: To quantify the influence of dataset origin on detection robustness, we define two comparative metrics that characterize the relative performance gap between real, simulated, and generative data :
paragraphs.zh: 为了量化数据集来源对检测鲁棒性的影响，我们定义了两个对比指标，用以描述真实数据、模拟数据和生成性数据之间的相对性能差距：

paragraphs.en: Δ sim→real \Delta_{\text{sim\textrightarrow real}} quantifies the simulation domain gap, reflecting the loss in realism induced by photometric, geometric, and material discrepancies, between Unity-rendered and real images. Δ gen→real \Delta_{\text{gen\textrightarrow real}} captures the generative bias introduced by Diffusion-based augmentation, encompassing both the visual realism and the semantic priors inherited from pretrained generative models.
paragraphs.zh: Δ sim→real \Delta_{\text{sim\textrightarrow real}} 量化了模拟域差距，反映了由光度、几何和材质差异所导致的 Unity 渲染图像与真实图像之间真实感上的损失。Δ gen→real \Delta_{\text{gen\textrightarrow real}} 捕捉了基于扩散模型的增强方法所引入的生成性偏差，该偏差既包括视觉真实感，也包括从预训练生成模型中继承而来的语义先验。

paragraphs.en: Together, these ratio-dependent metrics form a rigorous framework for assessing how simulation and generative synthesis contribute to real-world object detection robustness.
paragraphs.zh: 这些比率依赖的指标共同构成了一个严谨的框架，用于评估模拟和生成式合成如何提升真实世界中的物体检测鲁棒性。

paragraphs.en: In summary, our methodology provides a reproducible protocol for isolating and quantifying the effects of data origin. By controlling data mixture ratios, and maintaining identical training pipelines, we explicitly measure the trade-off between realism , controllability , and semantic bias . Thus, yielding actionable insights for data centric model design in computer vision applications.
paragraphs.zh: 总而言之，我们的方法为隔离和量化数据来源的影响提供了一种可重复的流程。 通过控制数据混合比例并保持完全相同的训练流程，我们明确测量了真实性、可控性和语义偏见之间的权衡关系。 因此，这为计算机视觉应用中以数据为中心模型的设计提供了具有实际指导意义的见解。

paragraphs.en: The results presented in Table 1 and Figure 4 reveal a nuanced interplay between dataset realism, diversity, and controllability in shaping generalization performance. Neither purely synthetic nor purely generative augmentation alone achieves optimal transferability. 10% CIA substitution insures the highest precision, while 10% Unity based substitution insures the highest recall. This precision–recall asymmetry is visually supported by the confusion matrices (Figure 3 ).
paragraphs.zh: 表 1 和图 4 中呈现的结果揭示了数据集的真实性、多样性和可控性在塑造泛化性能方面存在微妙的相互作用。 无论是纯合成增强还是纯生成增强，单独使用都无法达到最佳的迁移能力。10% 的 CIA 替换可确保最高的精确度，而 10% 的 Unity 基于替换则可确保最高的召回率。 这种精确度与召回率之间的不对称性得到了混淆矩阵（图 3）的直观支持。

paragraphs.en: The degradation observed for the Unity-only configuration (a drop of over 50% in mAP@0.5:0.95 relative to the real baseline) reflects the well-documented simulation-to-reality gap . Despite extensive domain randomization, Unity-rendered scenes diverge from real photometric distributions. Global illumination, specular reflections, and fine-grained textures remain simplified. This induces a representational bias where detectors overfit to synthetic regularities, such as unrealistic sharp edges. Nonetheless, introducing a limited fraction of simulated samples (10%) substantially improves recall and overall mAP. This improvement indicates that simulated data acts as a diversity regularizer. It plays a role in expanding geometric coverage and reducing overfitting to the narrow appearance manifold of the real subset.
paragraphs.zh: 仅使用 Unity 配置所观察到的性能下降（与真实基准相比，mAP@0.5:0.95 下降了超过 50%）反映了已有充分文献记载的模拟与现实之间的差距。 尽管进行了广泛的领域随机化，Unity 渲染的场景仍与真实的测光分布存在差异。 全局光照、镜面反射和精细纹理仍然被简化处理。 这会导致一种表示偏差，即检测器会对合成数据中的规律性特征（例如不真实的锐利边缘）过度拟合。 尽管如此，引入有限比例的模拟样本（10%）仍能显著提升召回率和整体 mAP。 这种改进表明，模拟数据起到了多样性正则化的作用。 它在扩展几何覆盖范围以及减少针对真实子集狭窄外观流形的过度拟合方面发挥了作用。

paragraphs.en: The CIA-only configuration exhibits a milder degradation, confirming that diffusion-based augmentation better preserves real-world statistics. Diffusion models inherit strong natural priors from large-scale image corpora. This knowledge allows for realistic illumination and texture reproduction. Hence, explaining the higher precision in Real-CIA mixtures. Particularly at 90%/10% ratios, where the model achieves the lowest recorded false-positive rate. The improvement suggests that CIA reinforces the photometric discriminability of the detector. However, recall remains comparatively limited, implying that generative augmentation introduces less geometric diversity. Diffusion-based synthesis primarily perturbs textures and lighting while maintaining similar spatial layouts, leading to photometric realism but limited structural novelty. Moreover, pretrained diffusion models can embed latent semantic biases from their internet-scale training corpora. Thus, favoring familiar object configurations and backgrounds over rare domain specific contexts.
paragraphs.zh: 仅使用 CIA 的配置表现出较轻微的退化，证实了基于扩散的增强方法能更好地保留真实世界的统计特性。 扩散模型从大规模图像语料中继承了强大的自然先验知识。 这种知识使得光照和纹理的再现能够更加逼真。 因此，这解释了 Real-CIA 混合数据中精度更高的原因。 尤其是在 90%/10% 的比例下，模型达到了记录在案的最低误报率。 这一改进表明，CIA 增强了检测器的光度判别能力。 然而，召回率仍然相对较低，这意味着生成式增强引入的几何多样性较少。 基于扩散的合成主要扰动纹理和光照，同时保持相似的空间布局，从而实现了光度的逼真性，但结构上的新颖性有限。 此外，预训练的扩散模型可能会嵌入其互联网级训练语料中存在的潜在语义偏见。 因此，它们更倾向于生成熟悉的物体配置和背景，而非罕见且领域特定的上下文。

sents.en: Moreover, pretrained diffusion models can embed latent semantic biases from their internet-scale training corpora.
sents.zh: 此外，预训练的扩散模型可能会嵌入其互联网级训练语料中存在的潜在语义偏见。

sents.en: Thus, favoring familiar object configurations and backgrounds over rare domain specific contexts.
sents.zh: 因此，它们更倾向于生成熟悉的物体配置和背景，而非罕见且领域特定的上下文。

paragraphs.en: The superior performance of the 90% Real + 10% Unity configuration demonstrates that a small synthetic contribution can enhance generalization without overwhelming the real data distribution. This composition combines Unity’s geometric variability with the contextual grounding of real data, offering complementary bias compensation. Yet, as mixing ratios increase, the divergence between simulation and reality grows, ultimately harming convergence and stability. Interestingly, tri-source compositions (e.g., 50/25/25) perform worse than their dual counterparts, suggesting that mixing simulation and generative domains simultaneously can introduce conflicting statistical cues. While Unity images broaden geometric space, CIA images densify photometric space. Excessive blending of both may confuse the model’s internal domain boundaries, leading to representational interference. These observations imply that hybrid training could benefit from progressive curriculum mixing . This is done starting with simulation-heavy training for structural generalization. Then, gradually transitioning toward CIA and real data for photometric alignment.
paragraphs.zh: 90%真实数据 + 10%Unity 配置所展现的优越性能表明，少量合成数据的引入能够提升模型泛化能力，而不会压倒真实数据的分布。 这种组合方式将 Unity 的几何多样性与真实数据的上下文锚定特性相结合，提供了互补的偏差补偿机制。 然而，随着混合比例的增加，模拟与现实之间的差异也会扩大，最终损害模型的收敛性和稳定性。 有趣的是，三源组合（例如 50/25/25）的表现反而不如双源组合，这表明同时混合模拟域和生成域可能会引入相互冲突的统计线索。 Unity 图像扩展了几何空间，而 CIA 图像则使光度空间更加密集。 过度混合这两种数据可能会混淆模型内部的域边界，从而导致表示干扰。 这些观察结果表明，混合训练或许能从渐进式课程混合中受益。 具体做法是，首先以高比例模拟数据的训练开始，以实现结构泛化。 然后逐步转向 CIA 和真实数据，以实现光度对齐。

sents.zh: 这些观察结果表明，混合训练或许能从渐进式课程混合中受益。

paragraphs.en: Aggregating Δ sim→real \Delta_{\text{sim\textrightarrow real}} and Δ gen→real \Delta_{\text{gen\textrightarrow real}} across all configurations highlights distinct decay patterns. Generative data maintains positive deltas for broader substitution ratios, whereas simulated data exhibits faster degradation. From a bias-variance perspective, Unity samples introduce high-variance perturbations that initially aid generalization, but quickly destabilize learning when the variance exceeds the model’s tolerance. paragraphs.en: Several avenues exist to further understand and enhance these effects. Feature-level analysis could reveal which network layers benefit most from each modality. As a result, distinguishing whether improvements occur at low-level edge encoding or high-level semantic abstraction. Evaluating models on out-of-domain real datasets (e.g., construction sites under novel lighting, culture, geography, etc.) would test whether the observed gains extend beyond intra-domain realism. Adaptive data selection strategies could also be explored, where Unity and CIA samples are dynamically sampled according to model uncertainty or feature-space coverage. Finally, integrating domain adaptation objectives such as adversarial feature alignment, or perceptual loss minimization, could mitigate residual distributional drift between mixed domains and the target real domain.

paragraphs.en: In conclusion, this study provides a principled framework for quantifying the relative contributions of simulated and generative data, in real-world object detection. The empirical results demonstrate that small, well-calibrated proportions of synthetic or generative data, can significantly enhance generalization. On the other hand, excessive inclusion induces domain drift. Unity data offers geometric variability, CIA offers photometric fidelity, and Real data provides semantic grounding. Their optimal combination maximizes performance without compromising realism. Future work will explore adaptive mixing schedules and cross-domain fine-tuning strategies, to dynamically balance these complementary effects. Grounding dataset composition in quantitative Δ \Delta metrics enables systematic, data-driven evaluation of how synthetic and generative sources influence model robustness and generalization.
paragraphs.zh: 总之，本研究为在真实世界目标检测中量化模拟数据和生成数据的相对贡献度提供了一个基于原则的框架。 实证结果表明，少量经过良好校准的合成或生成数据可以显著提升模型的泛化能力。 另一方面，过度引入此类数据会导致领域漂移。 Unity 数据提供了几何多样性，CIA 提供了光度保真度，而 Real 数据则提供了语义基础。 它们的最佳组合能够在不牺牲真实性的前提下最大化性能。 未来的工作将探索自适应混合方案和多领域微调策略，以动态平衡这些互补效应。 基于定量 Δ \Delta 指标来构建数据集，能够系统性地、以数据驱动的方式评估合成和生成数据源如何影响模型的鲁棒性和泛化能力。
